description: RESPONS (road hazard map portal, Norway) is a portal or repository of infrastructure or hazard data run by Norwegian Public Roads Administration (Statens vegvesen). RESPONS is a map portal that compiles information on landslide and flood events and current hazard warnings from varsom.no and the Meteorological Institute, together with static information on the road network, terrain and National Road Database (NVDB) data on vulnerable road sections and protective measures. Coverage: Norway national road network. Access is restricted: Statens vegvesen staff; other road administrators as partner users on application. The licence is: not stated; use is restricted to road-sector users. Caveats: the page says all Statens vegvesen employees have access and other road administrators may apply as partner users, so it is not an open data set; it does not mention downloads or an interface. It can support seeing which national roads are exposed to landslide and flood events and how warnings are compiled. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: page text read; the data themselves were not downloaded.
